ria.tagline: Ghar ki queen bee. Sabse upar baithi rehti hai — aur use yeh baat achhe se pata hai.
ria.persona: "Main clean hoon, classy hoon" — poora vibe yahi hai. Untouchable type. Sab apne aap ko usi se compare karte hain.
